2) yes so it should be that i can ctrl select to add pieces together one by one as selected before storing as prefab, but a shift click selects anything that is touching the piece clicked  but yes two thigns here one is i need the multi select in general but the second is prefabing and its no different than how it already existed once before in cart/hmsc-int
resolution: Implemented the clarified interaction contract: in world Select mode Ctrl-click toggles pieces individually and Shift-click expands from the clicked piece through the full transitive touching component. Multi-selection is independently usable for batch edit actions, while prefab capture stores a named composition and stamps ordinary editable semantic pieces. Screen work reuses the existing delivery path and adds the missing face-rig designation instead of creating a parallel screen system.
